title: Catchimals - using AI to identify animals and judge the actual photo
author: Catchimals
selftext:
I've been building Catchimals with AI help, using Flutter and Firebase. It's a real world animal collecting game: take pictures in the app, identify the animals and get a score for each shot.



One design choice I keep coming back to is that a good photo of a common animal should be able to beat a poor photo of a rare one. Identifying the animal and judging the photo are separate problems, so I treat them separately in the AI workflow. I use AI for artwork too.



For anyone using AI as a judge in a game, how are you checking that the scores make sense to the player?



Catchimals is on both stores. Free to download, with rewarded ads and optional purchases.



Google Play: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.catchimals.app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.catchimals.app)



App Store: [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/catchimals/id6777208751](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/catchimals/id6777208751)
